findings.text: follow-on: the real-home guard reads and asserts on the workstation's own configuration home (real_store_home()/crew/model-catalogue/snapshot.json) at fixture teardown; a concurrent crew process that refreshes the real catalogue rewrites that file and changes its mtime_ns, so the assertion can redden on a legitimate peer action rather than on a defect. It is vacuous only while the host catalogue is unconfigured; the landed follow_ons has the coordinator configure the host catalogue after landing, after which the window opens.
